text:
DOSL7::disable
Description
Disables blocking and detection of DoS attacks according to the ASM
security policy configuration. When enabled using
DOSL7::enable
, transactions will be enforced
according to the DoS L7 ASM policy configuration for both detection
and prevention.
Syntax
DOSL7
::
disable
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
DOSL7
::
disable
}
